intent: Extend existing CAP-0003/CAP-0004 grounded projection seams so a source-grounded numeric forecast and directly comparable numeric Reality can be persisted and evaluated without flattening values into text or inventing a correctness threshold. Reuse existing Fact/Judgment numeric fields, FactDimensions comparability hashing, the existing PostgreSQL semantic catalog and Outcome numeric_error columns; add no new semantic owner or schema shape.
rationale_summary: The Gartner 2024 PC forecast/revision packet is a concrete source-grounded case that existing database/domain owners can represent. The bounded helpers needed numeric wiring; the first production attempt also used an ad-hoc pct_yoy unit even though 0003_research_domains.sql already seeds the canonical ratio unit. This remains an extension of CAP-0003/CAP-0004: reuse the existing catalog vocabulary, register the claim-specific PC YoY-growth predicate against ratio, and compare fail-closed on predicate/dimensions/unit identity while preserving preliminary status and no-lookahead.
